about: Port Hope is a municipality on Lake Ontario in Northumberland County, Ontario, at the mouth of the Ganaraska River. A well-preserved historic downtown, theatre culture, and a working harbour define the lakefront centre; the amalgamated municipality also includes inland rural areas. Highway 401 and County Road 2 pass nearby. About 17,000 people live in Port Hope.
seoSummary: Lake Ontario municipality at the Ganaraska River mouth, known for a historic downtown and harbour.
